preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of k is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a string of length between 1 and len(S) - k.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if len(S) == 2^m for some integer m else len(S) - k == 2^m for some integer m
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if the length of the string after removal of k characters is not a power of 2, otherwise the length of the output string is a power of 2.
The output string is the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained by removing exactly k characters from S.
